build_convbert_model: build a ConvBertModel with ConvBertConfig for extracting sequence hidden states from input token IDs
run_convbert_masked_lm: run ConvBertForMaskedLM to predict masked tokens in a sequence using cross-entropy loss
run_convbert_sequence_classification: run ConvBertForSequenceClassification to classify sequences into num_labels categories
run_convbert_question_answering: run ConvBertForQuestionAnswering to predict start and end token positions for answer spans
run_convbert_token_classification: run ConvBertForTokenClassification to assign label tags to each token in a sequence
